audience: scheduling teams using an API-enabled TimeTap Business or Enterprise account

useCases.title: Review appointments for a date range
useCases.text: List a date range of appointments, filter by staff, location or service, and continue through result pages to review scheduled times and status.

useCases.title: Compare services for staff and locations
useCases.text: Find scheduling staff and locations, then list services for a selected staff member or location to compare durations and prices.

useCases.title: Inspect an appointment’s time and status
useCases.text: Read an appointment by its ID to check its time, status, staff, location and service. Client records, notes and private management links are omitted.

useCases.title: Review a location’s scheduling staff
useCases.text: Find a scheduling location and list the staff who accept appointments there, using their IDs, names and scheduling flags.
